verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents ZCode automatically building or recalling agent memory across sessions. The nearest items are adjacent features that do not deliver the story: preserved session data on reinstall (zcode-gh-11), an app data directory (zcode-gh-8), and Goal-based multi-step planning (zcode-docs-2).

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
